description: The one Whispering window. Through the folder plugin the page opens the two roots Rust names at startup, by name: Whispering's AppData root, whose shortcuts.md it reads (localFile from @epicenter/local), and its data folder (home from @epicenter/folder), ~/Epicenter/whispering, which its bundle identifier names and which the first open makes when nothing is there. The page holds no path but the one it shows. No capability names a folder. Through the folder plugin it may ask Epicenter to sync the data folder (epicenter://init) and whether Epicenter already does. It records from the shell's microphone into that folder, transcribes audio on this computer and administers the local models, holds the global shortcut it resolved from shortcuts.md (set_shortcut) and hears its presses (core:event), signs in with Epicenter and sends the account's requests with a token it never holds, reads who is signed in from account.json in its AppData root, which only the shell writes, saves its connected endpoints' keys to the shell's credentials file (credentials.json in the AppData root, which the page never reads), and sends its requests to them, and to Ollama and LM Studio on this computer, through the shell, which adds a connection's key and sends only to the endpoint the key was saved for (connection_fetch).
